title: [console 17.0.0-rc.0] Action params dialog: lookup param always renders 'no reference object configured' helpText even when reference is set and the picker works
body:
## Summary

In the record-header action params dialog (RecordDetailView), a `lookup`-type action param renders the warning helpText **"该参数未配置引用对象，无法使用记录选择器。请直接填写记录 ID，或联系管理员修正该动作参数。"** (`actionDialog.lookupHelpText`) **unconditionally** — even when `reference` IS configured and the record selector works perfectly.

## Repro (17.0.0-rc.0)

Object action with an inline lookup param, canonical spelling per `ActionParamSchema`:

```ts
{
  name: 'set_manager', label: '设置管理责任人', mode: 'custom',
  locations: ['record_header'], type: 'api', method: 'POST',
  target: '/api/v1/ts/record-action/<object>', recordIdParam: 'recordId',
  params: [{ name: 'manager', label: '管理责任人', type: 'lookup', reference: 'sys_user', required: true }],
}
```

Open the action from a record detail page → params dialog shows the lookup control (search input + grid-picker button):

- ✅ Grid button opens a fully functional record selector (queries `sys_user`, search filter works, row click selects and fills the chip);
- ❌ Below the control, `actionDialog.lookupHelpText` ("param has no reference object, selector unusable, paste a raw record id") is displayed anyway.

Same behavior with the field-reference param style (`{ field: 'manager', required: true }`).

## Root cause (from the shipped asset)

In the dialog's param renderer (RecordDetailView chunk), the helpText branch is:

```js
u && !t.helpText && jsx('p', { children: n('actionDialog.lookupHelpText') })
// u = t.type === 'lookup' || t.type === 'reference'
```

i.e. the message claiming "reference not configured" is gated only on **"param is a lookup and has no custom helpText"** — it never checks whether `referenceTo` resolved. The degradation check that the message describes lives elsewhere (`zt()`: `Rt.has(type) && !e.referenceTo → type='text'`) and is not part of this condition.

## Expected

Show `lookupHelpText` only when the param actually degraded to the raw-id text input (i.e. `referenceTo` missing), mirroring the `lookupPlaceholder` branch which already checks `a.type === 'text'`.

## Impact

Every record-header action with a lookup param permanently displays a scary red-herring telling users the picker is broken and to paste raw record ids; users don't discover the (working) grid picker. Registered on our side as PLAT-DEF-027.

## Workaround

Setting a custom `helpText` on the param suppresses the misreport (the condition includes `!t.helpText`).
